summary.zh: 吉祥物乘交通工具一镜到底横穿一座扁平插画城市，每个街区是一个内容类别，路边广告牌是代表内容，天色从白天走到夜晚，落版到产品界面和数据卡。适合内容多、类别清楚的产品（内容平台、多功能软件、多门店多品类、课程体系）
summary.en: A mascot rides through a flat-illustrated city in one continuous take; each district is a content category, roadside billboards carry sample titles, the sky moves from day to night, and it lands on the product screen with a stat card. Fits products with many clearly separated categories
